headline: Executive order sets the order in which Justice Department officials would step in to run the department if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order lays out a line of succession inside the Department of Justice. It says which officials would act as Attorney General, in what order, if the Attorney General and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so specific details are not available.

who_it_affects.how: They may be named in a set order to temporarily lead the department if higher-ranking leaders are unavailable.
